fields.notes:
He belonged to the lineage of Gadādhara Ṭhākura (Caitanya Caritāmṛta 1.12.84; Sakhanirnayamrta 22; the record «Śrīhari Ācārya» gave Sakhanirnayamrta 33 and Jayānanda's Caitanya-maṅgala 83).

Bhakti-ratnākara 10 (pp. 635–636): named among the mahāntas who joined Jāhnavā Īśvarī's party at Kaṇṭaka-nagara and went with it to the festival at Kheturi.

The record «Śrīhari Ācārya» #1439 was the same person and was joined to this one (15-11-2026, Whisper).
